description: Look up RockAuto parts by keyword, part number, vehicle fitment, or a pasted RockAuto URL. Returns prices, core charges, fitment notes and optional part details.

categoryFilter.description: Only keep records whose category, part type, part group or description matches this text (case-insensitive), e.g. `Brake Pad`, `Oil Filter`.
categoryFilter.title: Category / part-type filter

customProxyUrls.description: Optional premium proxy URLs in `http://user:pass@host:port` form to try before Apify's residential pool. Not needed for normal use.
customProxyUrls.title: Custom proxy URLs (advanced)

enrichWithPartDetails.description: Also fetch each part's more-info page for specifications, warranty, OEM / interchange numbers, features and product images. Adds one request per emitted part.
enrichWithPartDetails.title: Fetch part detail pages

gradeFilter.description: Only keep records in this RockAuto quality group. Applies to catalog and URL modes, which carry RockAuto's grade labels. Leave empty for all grades.
gradeFilter.title: Quality grade

inStockOnly.description: Drop records RockAuto explicitly marks out of stock.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeFitment.description: Also fetch each part's buyer's-guide fitment table (make, model, year range). Adds one request per emitted part.
includeFitment.title: Fetch fitment applications

manufacturerFilter.description: Only keep records whose manufacturer matches this text (case-insensitive). In `search` mode it is also sent to RockAuto so the 50-result page is filtered at the source.
manufacturerFilter.title: Manufacturer filter

maxPrice.description: Drop records priced above this amount. Records without a parsed price are kept.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

maxResults.description: Hard cap on parts emitted across all inputs, after deduplication and filtering.
maxResults.title: Max results

minPrice.description: Drop records priced below this amount. Records without a parsed price are kept.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

mode.description: How to look up parts. `search` runs a keyword or part-number search; `catalog` walks a vehicle (year/make/model/engine) to a part type; `partNumber` finds interchange equivalents; `urls` scrapes pasted RockAuto URLs. When omitted, the actor infers the mode from the fields you filled in.
mode.title: Lookup mode

partNumbers.description: Part numbers for `partNumber` mode (e.g. `PH2808`, `51334`). RockAuto returns matching parts from every brand, with live prices and a fitment buyer's guide.
partNumbers.title: Part numbers

queries.description: One or more search terms. In `search` mode use part numbers, brands, or categories (e.g. `BREMBO P28004`, `oil filter`, `brake pads`). In `catalog` mode use the part type to open for the chosen vehicle (e.g. `brake pad`, `alternator`, `cabin air filter`).
queries.title: Search queries / part terms

startUrls.description: Paste RockAuto part-search, catalog or more-info URLs. A part-type URL returns that page; a category or engine URL is expanded into its part-type pages until `maxResults` is reached; a more-info URL returns that part's detail record.
startUrls.title: RockAuto URLs

vehicleEngine.description: Catalog mode: engine, e.g. `2.5L L4`, `5.7L V8 Hemi`. Optional — the first matching engine is used when omitted.
vehicleEngine.title: Vehicle engine

title: RockAuto Catalog Price & Fitment Lookup Input
